title: Wonder, Inspire, Change posters

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Give a campaign a repeatable structure so different subjects remain recognizably related.
strategic_value: A common black field and vertical action words can connect diverse natural specimens to the Museum’s active role.
demonstration: Three framed posters pair vivid specimens with a colored symbol at upper left and large vertical words: WONDER, INSPIRE and CHANGE.
practical_value: Compare the constant hierarchy with the changing specimen and accent color.

content_islands.name: Poster trio
content_islands.spec: Align the three framed black posters side by side in the architectural setting.

content_islands.name: Recurring hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Repeat the symbol near the upper left and vertical white word along the right edge.

content_islands.name: Specimen imagery
content_islands.spec: Give each poster a different brightly colored natural specimen against black.

reference_purposes.Application: Three framed posters pair vivid specimens with a colored symbol at upper left and large vertical words: WONDER, INSPIRE and CHANGE.
